name: Very Light Pink
lede: Very Light Pink pairs the modifier "very light" with [[pink]], and our data finds it is an exact duplicate, at this hex, of Blush White.

sections.title: A near-white modifier
sections.body:
Like other "very light" names, this one is built from a modifier on the base color [[pink]], first recorded in our sources through the xkcd 2010 crowd color survey [1]. Our own data finds it an exact match, 0.0 units apart, with the name Blush White, so the two point to the same practical color [2].

Its nearest distinct look-alikes are [[lavender-blush]] (4.0 units, almost the same) and [[linen]] (4.3, almost the same), with plain [[white]] not far behind (5.1) [3].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: No painting in our 23,781-painting archive holds this color across at least one percent of its canvas, as photographed [4]. A near-white this close to the page itself is easy for a photograph of an aged, varnished canvas to miss or wash out, so the absence says more about the archive's method than about any painter's choices [4]. In LCH terms it measures lightness 97, chroma 4 and hue 34 degrees, barely tinted off pure white [4].
